_comment: TB-direct read-plane test fixture (design §5). Mirrors the shape TB returns from GET /api/tenant/devices?textSearch=... — a PageData { data:[device], hasNext, totalElements }. The plain Device entity has NO `active`/`lastActivityTime` (OOHDASH-80: the earlier /api/tenant/deviceInfos swap, PR #33, was WRONG — that endpoint does not exist on this TB and 400s, breaking all inventory). Online status is sourced per-device from SERVER_SCOPE `active` (GET /api/plugins/telemetry/DEVICE/{uuid}/values/attributes/SERVER_SCOPE?keys=active,lastActivityTime → [{key,value}]). The `active` field below feeds the test adapter's SERVER_SCOPE route (stripped from the device-list response). Plus per-device latest-telemetry { key:[{ts,value}] } from .../values/timeseries. Keyed by tbName. The 6261 set includes a bleed neighbour (gk-62611) so the anchored client-side filter is exercised; names carry realistic C4 exception classes.
